metadata.description: Independent native Qwen service extensions from Ace Data Cloud. Add this source to discover and install individual services.

plugins.name: suno-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate Suno music and retrieve completed audio through Ace Data Cloud. Source prerelease: official Qwen native credential fix #14544 is not released; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: seedance-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate Seedance videos and retrieve the same task through Ace Data Cloud. Source prerelease: official Qwen native credential fix #14544 is not released; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: happyhorse-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate and edit HappyHorse videos through Ace Data Cloud; retrieve the original task. Source prerelease: official Qwen native credential fix #14544 is not released; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: gpt-image-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: GPT Image generation, editing and task retrieval through Ace Data Cloud. Dedicated five-tool stdio profile; requires uv/uvx and Python 3.10+. Source RC: official Qwen fix #14544 remains unreleased; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: nano-banana-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate and edit Nano Banana images through Ace Data Cloud; query the same task for results. Source prerelease: official Qwen native credential fix #14544 is not released; synthetic setup only.

plugins.name: ace-music-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Create ACE Music songs and lyrics, upload reference audio, cover one owned track, blend two, and retrieve the original task.

plugins.name: google-search-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Search Google web, images, or news with Ace Data Cloud. Inspect supported search types locally before a billable lookup.

plugins.name: seedream-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Create or edit Seedream images through Ace Data Cloud and check the original task ID. Inspect supported models and sizes locally.

plugins.name: fish-audio-by-ace-data-cloud
plugins.description: Generate speech with Fish Audio through Ace Data Cloud and check an existing task. Read the local usage guide before synthesis.

plugins.name: kling
plugins.description: Create a Kling video from text or an image and retrieve the finished clip using its task ID. The Ace Data Cloud integration bills video requests to your account.

plugins.name: veo
plugins.description: Create a Veo video from text or reference frames, then check the original task for the result. The Ace Data Cloud integration bills video requests to your account.
